A little more clarity

Do I need an account to explore the tools?

No. Read the guides and try the public budget calculator, checklist and timeline without signing in. Create an account to manage your own saved wedding plans.

Can I manage invitations and RSVPs?

Your couple dashboard includes guests, invitation links, groups and reply permissions, with RSVP tracking in one place.

Where should we start?

Agree on a comfortable budget, a rough guest count and the three things that matter most. Our full wedding planning guide walks through the next decisions.

Will the public tools save to my dashboard?

Public tools are a starting point. Checklist ticks are saved in this browser; your private dashboard has its own personal planning records.

How do I keep supplier conversations together?

Create a couple account, find a supplier and choose Start a chat. Your conversations stay together in the Messages tab.

Can we change the example timeline?

Yes. Adjust ceremony time and the moments in the public timeline, then print a starting point to discuss with your venue and suppliers.

How can WedSparks make our budget go further?

Every complete $10,000 of money paid through WedSparks earns $1,000 in wedding credits for further supplier payments through the platform. Amounts covered by credits do not earn more credits.
